name: perseus
display_name: Perseus — Live Context for MCP Hosts
description: Live workspace context engine for AI agents. Resolves project files, git state, services, and memory into ready-to-use context before every turn. Local-first, MCP-native.
long_description:
Perseus eliminates cold-start orientation for AI agents. It is a compile-before-context engine that resolves directives (@file, @git, @memory, @services, @search) into a ready context block injected before every agent session.

- **Zero orientation** — your agent receives project state immediately, without an orientation detour

- **MCP-native** — works as an MCP server for live context resolution

- **Local-first** — all resolution happens on your filesystem, no data leaves your machine

- **Multi-assistant** — works with Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, Hermes Agent, and any MCP host

- **Pairs with Perseus Vault** — persistent cross-session memory through a local MCP backend; see the [versioned Vault MCP API reference](https://perseus.observer/vault/mcp-reference/) for its published surface

Install: `pip install perseus-ctx && cd your-project && perseus quickstart`
